claims.text: lintOperability requires exactly one banner, primary nav, main and application-updates status landmark plus kind screen skip control, and exactly one exposed H1.
The lint flags clickable_non_native, bad_state for positive tabindex and unknown ARIA attributes, and bad_selector for unknown data-lin attributes, duplicate entity tuples and identity collisions.
Controls must expose unique normalized names within the 64-byte budget, registered data-lin-action values and unambiguous action scopes.

decision.rule: Change here when operability lint rules, landmark expectations or control naming budgets need to change.
decision.failure: Screens ship without landmarks or accessible names, duplicate control names appear, or actions become unavailable from identity collisions.
